title: Frame
description: x-frame holds its first child to an aspect ratio: it sets --x-frame-ratio from ratio (default 16/9) and makes the child fill the frame.

ratio.description: Width-to-height shape the first child is held to, written as width/height: 16/9, 4/3, 1/1.
